title: ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Trajectory Benchmark for Long-Horizon Agent Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-step agent trajectories to detect unjust, biased, or inequitable outcomes, such as the unfair allocation of resources or opportunities (e.g., an agent unfairly denying financial access based on corrupted tool feedback).

Assessing long-horizon agent interactions against a safety taxonomy to identify behaviors that reinforce systemic discrimination, produce harmful representational stereotypes, or amplify structural biases within the broader information ecosystem.
